options.name: api_key
options.description: UptimeRobot API key. See C(uptimerobot_monitor) for the resolution order.

options.name: api_key_file
options.description: Path to a file whose first line is the UptimeRobot API key. Tilde-expanded.

options.name: friendly_name
options.description: Friendly name of the alert contact to delete. Exact match. Required if I(id) is not given.

options.name: id
options.description: Numeric ID of the alert contact. Required if I(friendly_name) is not given. Takes precedence when both are set.

options.name: state
options.description: Only C(absent) is supported. C(present) is rejected because UptimeRobot's v2 API does not expose contact creation or editing.
